# rd_replay_tool_glow_hold (port/render/test/rd_replay_tool_glow_hold.cmake):
# the glow held between ticks against its chain drawn at every present.  A
# name a line, with its role: still (the still case: the frame as its own tick
# before), prev and move (the moving case: two consecutive ticks, prev the
# tick before; one of each).  nocull replays that case with ICO_RD_CULL=off
# (the generated lamps are in the chain then: the LAMPS plan); a QUANTITY OP
# VALUE word declares what the fixture shows at the test's setting
# (rd_fixture_list_props.cmake), checked on a replay of the fixture alone
# with the chain drawn at every present.
#
# the still case: the title's castle, a corpus frame of 2026-10-06 (512x512
# GS, as the lost godrays frames: no columns cropped at 4:3), the sun's fans on
# the picture (the chain drawn whole)
fx-boot-0200 still glow_chains>=1 glow_plan=whole
# the moving case: issue 123's Adreno 740 tablet, frame 6312 then 6313 (576x448
# GS), the lamps' chain.  On the generated frames the held glow of present 1 is
# the redrawn one byte for byte and WORK2 holds no mask (DIFF 0, MASK 0): the
# moving case checks the lines and present 0, its region rule has nothing to
# bound here
fx-adreno-prev prev nocull glow_chains>=1 glow_plan=lamps
fx-adreno move nocull glow_chains>=1 glow_plan=lamps
